mapper.select: SELECT status,COUNT(*) total FROM openlb_pmid_task GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
mapper.update: UPDATE openlb_pmid_task t SET status='SUCCESS',completed_time=COALESCE(completed_time,NOW()),last_error=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM openlb_publication p WHERE p.pmid=t.pmid)
UPDATE openlb_pmid_task SET status='RUNNING',last_attempt_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE status='PENDING' AND pmid IN #{pmid}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO openlb_publication(pmid,doi,title,abstract_text,pub_year,journal_title,source_url, authors_json,affiliation_info,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,raw_payload,source_hash,fetched_at) VALUES
(#{row.pmid},#{row.doi},#{row.title},#{row.abstractText},#{row.pubYear},#{row.journalTitle},#{row.sourceUrl}, #{row.authorsJson},#{row.affiliationInfo},#{row.keywordList},#{row.meshHeadingsJson},#{row.grantsJson}, #{row.cncbBanksJson},#{row.rawPayload},#{row.sourceHash},NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary=1, relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), doi=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(doi),doi), pub_year=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(pub_year),pub_year), journal_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(journal_title),journal_title), title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(title),title), abstract_text=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(abstract_text),abstract_text), source_url=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(source_url),source_url), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), keyword_list=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), authors_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), grants_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(raw_payload),raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)
mapper.update: UPDATE openlb_pmid_task SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1, status=IF(attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts},'FAILED','PENDING'), last_error=CASE pmid WHEN #{row.pmid} THEN #{row.error} ELSE last_error END, next_retry_time=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL LEAST(300,5*attempt_count*attempt_count) SECOND), update_time=NOW() WHERE pmid IN #{row.pmid}
